for general information:--

the Electricity (Amendment) Ordinance, 1998.
(2)-It shall come into force at
once.

Addition of new section 50-A, Act IX of 1910

ORDINANCE XVIII OF 1998 .
ELECTRICITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1998
An Ordinance further to amend the Electricity Act, 1910
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 22nd December, 1998]
F.No.2(1)/98-Pub., dated
22-12-1998.--The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published
for general information:--
4. Addition of new section 50-A, Act IX of 1910.--In the said Act,
after section 50, the following new section shall be inserted, namely:--
"50-A.
Cognizance of offences, etc.--(1) No Court inferior to that of a Magistrate of
the First Class shall try an offence punishable under this Ordinance.
(2)
Notwithstanding anything contained in section 32 of the Code of Criminal
Procedure, 1898 (Act V of 1898), it shall be lawful for any Magistrate of the
first class to pass any sentence authorised by this Ordinance. ".
